lastText: File ClosedThe Ring, Closed After the FactMinor VictorySoviet High Command, 1941 — 1945End of hostilities: NOVEMBER 1945 (PROJECTED) — filed late, out of sequenceImmediate AftermathVictory in Europe arrives around November 1945 — later than the historical May 1945, the price of choices that spent time to save men. The army that reaches Berlin has paid for the ground twice over — a war fought closer to the historical pattern of holding rigid lines regardless of the arithmetic, at the cost this campaign keeps returning to. The industrial evacuation was subordinated to front supply in 1941 — easing that autumn's crisis at a cost in Urals production capacity that every later year of this campaign quietly pays for. Operation Mars was scaled back rather than launched at full strength — sparing the Rzhev grinder's historical cost, a battle Soviet archives ██████████ stayed quiet about for fifty years. The push straight for Berlin in ████████ was actually attempted here — testing Chuikov's postwar █████ against the flank risk Zhukov's own staff warned about, rather than leaving the question a memoir argument. No branch of this ████████ reaches a different destination — only the timing and the price were ever in Soviet hands.One Year LaterVictory arrived behind the historical May 1945, which means ██████ forces are still consolidating a front the historical record had a year's head start settling by this point.
